form.label: Zeek SMB and Windows Domain Analysis
form.description: SMB shares and files, DCE/RPC calls, NTLM and Kerberos logons, LDAP searches and lateral movement checks from Zeek logs. Click a pie slice to fill the matching filter box; type * in a box to clear it.

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:smb_mapping $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval share=upper(mvindex(split(path,"\\"),-1)), server_name=upper(mvindex(split(path,"\\"),2)) | eval share_class=case(share="IPC$$","IPC$$ - named pipes for RPC", share="ADMIN$$","ADMIN$$ - Windows folder (admin only)", match(share,"^[A-Z]\$$$$"),"Drive admin share (C$$ etc.)", share="SYSVOL" OR share="NETLOGON","SYSVOL / NETLOGON - Group Policy and logon scripts", like(share,"%$$"),"Other hidden share", true(),"Normal share") | fillnull value="-" share server_name share_type service native_file_system share_class | stats count min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h path share server_name share_class share_type service native_file_system

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:ntlm $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval result=case(success="true" OR success="T","success", success="false" OR success="F","FAILED", true(),"no result seen") | eval user=if(len(username)>0, username."@".coalesce(domainname,"?"), "(no user name seen)") | fillnull value="-" hostname server_nb_computer_name server_dns_computer_name server_tree_name domainname | stats count min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p user hostname server_nb_computer_name result

index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:kerberos $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval result=case(success="true","success", isnotnull(error_msg), error_msg, success="false","failed", true(),"no reply seen") | eval account=lower(mvindex(split(client,"/"),0)), acct_type=case(like(account,"%$$"),"computer", len(account)>0,"user", true(),"(hidden in ticket)") | fillnull value="-" request_type service cipher account | stats count min(ts) as first max(ts) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h request_type account acct_type service cipher result

input.label: Time range (All time for old PCAPs)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn | stats count by pcap_case | eval filter="pcap_case=\"".pcap_case."\"" | sort pcap_case

div.p: Read this first. SMB (TCP 445) is Windows file sharing. A client first maps a share (smb_mapping: \\SERVER\SHARE), then opens files on it (smb_files). The special share IPC$$ holds named pipes - doors to Windows services. Through a pipe (or a high TCP port found via port 135) the client makes DCE/RPC calls (dce_rpc: endpoint = which service, operation = which function). Logons appear in ntlm and kerberos.

Normal: PCs talk to the domain controller - IPC$$, SYSVOL, NETLOGON, calls to lsarpc / samr / netlogon / drsuapi at logon. Look closer: PC to PC SMB, ADMIN$$ or C$$, a program written to a share, svcctl / atsvc / ITaskSchedulerService / IWbemServices calls, DRSGetNCChanges from a non-DC, bursts of the same call, many NTLM failures.

Filters: click a pie slice to put its value in the matching box above (pipe, endpoint, operation, action, share, user). Timelines and detail tables then show only that value. Type * to clear. Click a row in section H to open all logs of that connection.

panel.title: A1. SMB connections

search.query: | stats sum(sessions) as v

panel.title: A2. SMB clients

search.query: | stats dc(id_orig_h) as v

panel.title: A3. SMB servers

search.query: | stats dc(id_resp_h) as v

panel.title: A4. Shares mapped

search.query: | stats dc(path) as v

panel.title: A5. Files touched (not IPC$$)

search.query: | where share!="IPC$$" | stats dc(name) as v

panel.title: A6. DCE/RPC calls

search.query: | stats sum(count) as v

panel.title: A7. Different RPC operations

search.query: | stats dc(operation) as v

panel.title: A8. HIGH-risk RPC calls

search.query: | where sev="HIGH" | stats sum(count) as v | eval v=coalesce(v,0)

panel.title: A9. Admin share mappings (ADMIN$$, C$$ ...)

search.query: | where like(share,"%$$") AND share!="IPC$$" | stats sum(count) as v | eval v=coalesce(v,0)

panel.title: A10. NTLM logons

search.query: | stats sum(count) as v

panel.title: A11. NTLM failures

search.query: | where result="FAILED" | stats sum(count) as v | eval v=coalesce(v,0)

panel.title: A12. Kerberos errors (not PREAUTH_REQUIRED)

search.query: | where result!="success" AND result!="KDC_ERR_PREAUTH_REQUIRED" AND result!="no reply seen" AND result!="KRB_ERR_RESPONSE_TOO_BIG" | stats sum(count) as v | eval v=coalesce(v,0)

panel.title: B1. SMB client to server pairs (conn.log, ports 445/139)

search.query: | stats sum(sessions) as sessions sum(out) as out sum(in) as in sum(dur) as dur min(first) as first max(last) as last values(conn_state) as states by id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p | eval KB_sent=round(out/1024,1), KB_received=round(in/1024,1), seconds=round(dur,1) | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table id_orig_h id_resp_h id_resp_p sessions KB_sent KB_received seconds states first last | sort - sessions

panel.title: B2. SMB connection states

search.query: | eval state=case(conn_state="SF","SF - opened and closed normally", conn_state="S0","S0 - no reply", conn_state="REJ","REJ - rejected", conn_state="S1","S1 - open, never closed", conn_state="S2","S2 - client closed, no server reply", conn_state="S3","S3 - server closed, no client reply", conn_state="RSTO","RSTO - client sent reset", conn_state="RSTR","RSTR - server sent reset", conn_state="RSTOS0","RSTOS0 - SYN then reset, no reply", conn_state="RSTRH","RSTRH - server SYN-ACK then reset", conn_state="SH","SH - SYN then FIN, no reply", conn_state="SHR","SHR - server SYN-ACK and FIN only", conn_state="OTH","OTH - no SYN seen (mid-stream)", true(), conn_state) | stats sum(sessions) as sessions by state | sort - sessions

panel.title: B3. Most SMB data per pair (KB)

search.query: | stats sum(out) as out sum(in) as in by id_orig_h id_resp_h | eval total=out+in | sort - total | head 10 | eval pair=id_orig_h." > ".id_resp_h, KB_sent=round(out/1024,1), KB_received=round(in/1024,1) | table pair KB_sent KB_received

panel.title: B4. Failed SMB connections and scanning (one source, many targets)

search.query: | eval failed=if(conn_state="S0" OR conn_state="REJ" OR conn_state="RSTOS0" OR conn_state="SH" OR conn_state="RSTRH", sessions, 0) | stats sum(sessions) as attempts sum(failed) as failed dc(id_resp_h) as targets values(id_resp_h) as target_list min(first) as first max(last) as last by id_orig_h | eval fail_pct=round(100*failed/attempts,0), target_list=mvindex(target_list,0,9) | eval verdict=case(targets>=10 AND fail_pct>=50,"Likely SMB scanning or worm spread", targets>=5,"Many SMB targets - check", attempts>=10 AND fail_pct>=80,"Repeated failed SMB connections", true(),"") | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table id_orig_h attempts failed fail_pct targets target_list verdict first last | sort - targets

panel.title: B5. SMB connections over time

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:conn $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") (id_resp_p=445 OR id_resp_p=139 OR service="*smb*") | eval _time=ts | timechart span=$span$ limit=10 useother=t count by $smbconn_split$

panel.title: C1. RPC Named Pipe (click to filter)

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls by pipe | sort - calls

panel.title: C2. DCE_RPC Endpoint (click to filter)

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls by endpoint | sort - calls

panel.title: C3. RPC Operations (click to filter)

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls by operation | sort - calls

panel.title: C4. RPC calls by risk level

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls by sev

panel.title: C5. Risky RPC calls (HIGH, MEDIUM, LOW) with ATT&CK technique

search.query: | where sev!="INFO" | stats sum(count) as calls min(first) as first max(last) as last values(pipe) as pipes by sev category meaning attack id_orig_h id_resp_h endpoint operation | eval order=case(sev="HIGH",1, sev="MEDIUM",2, true(),3) | sort order, first | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table sev category meaning attack id_orig_h id_resp_h endpoint operation pipes calls first last

panel.title: C6. Endpoint and operation map - what was called, how often, by how many hosts

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls dc(id_orig_h) as clients dc(id_resp_h) as servers values(pipe) as pipes min(first) as first max(last) as last by sev endpoint operation meaning | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort - calls | table sev endpoint operation calls clients servers pipes meaning first last

panel.title: C7. Which pipe or port carried which endpoint

search.query: | stats sum(count) as calls values(endpoint) as endpoints dc(id_orig_h) as clients by pipe id_resp_p | sort - calls

panel.title: C8. Bursts - the same RPC call 50+ times in one minute (guessing, enumeration, Zerologon)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:dce_rpc $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | fillnull value="-" endpoint operation | eval _time=ts | bin _time span=1m | stats count as calls by _time id_orig_h id_resp_h endpoint operation | where calls>=50 | eval minute=strftime(_time,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M") | sort - calls | table minute id_orig_h id_resp_h endpoint operation calls

panel.title: D1. SMB Files action (click to filter)

search.query: | stats sum(count) as events by act | sort - events

panel.title: D2. SMB files by share (click to filter)

search.query: | stats sum(count) as events by share | sort - events

panel.title: D3. SMB file extensions (not IPC$$)

search.query: | where share!="IPC$$" | stats sum(count) as events by ext | sort - events

panel.title: D4. SMB Files Timeline (uses the action / share boxes)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:smb_files $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval act=replace(action,"SMB::",""), share=upper(mvindex(split(path,"\\"),-1)), fname=mvindex(split(name,"\\"),-1) | eval ext=if(match(fname,"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6}$$"), lower(mvindex(split(fname,"."),-1)), "(none)") | fillnull value="-" act share name fname ext | search act="$act$" share="$share$" | eval _time=ts | timechart span=$span$ limit=10 useother=t count by $smbf_split$

panel.title: D5. SMB Files Timeline - every file event in time order (click a row to open its uid)

search.query: index=$idx$ sourcetype=zeek:smb_files $case$ (id_orig_h="$ip$" OR id_resp_h="$ip$") | eval act=replace(action,"SMB::",""), share=upper(mvindex(split(path,"\\"),-1)), fname=mvindex(split(name,"\\"),-1) | eval ext=if(match(fname,"\.[A-Za-z0-9]{1,6}$$"), lower(mvindex(split(fname,"."),-1)), "(none)") | fillnull value="-" act share name fname ext | search act="$act$" share="$share$" | sort 0 ts | head 5000 | eval time=strftime(ts,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.%3N"), KB=round(size/1024,1), created=strftime(times_created,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), modified=strftime(times_modified,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | table time id_orig_h id_resp_h act share name prev_name KB created modified uid fuid

panel.title: D6. Programs and scripts on SMB shares (ADMIN$$ / C$$ = remote execution sign)

search.query: | where match(ext,"^(exe|dll|scr|sys|ps1|psm1|bat|cmd|vbs|vbe|js|jse|wsf|hta|msi|lnk|jar|py)$$") | eval on_admin_share=if(like(share,"%$$") AND share!="IPC$$","YES","") | stats sum(count) as events values(act) as actions max(size) as size min(first) as first max(last) as last by id_orig_h id_resp_h share name on_admin_share | eval first=strftime(first,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S"), last=strftime(last,"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S") | sort first | table first id_orig_h id_resp_h share name on_admin_share actions size events last
